name: The Shops at Santa Anita
description: Westfield Santa Anita is a premier shopping destination in the San Gabriel Valley, featuring an impressive collection of top retailers, diverse dining options, and family-friendly entertainment experiences. This enclosed regional mall offers a sophisticated shopping environment with both upscale and mainstream brands, anchored by major department stores and complemented by convenient amenities throughout the center.
demographics: Westfield Santa Anita primarily serves affluent families and Asian-American communities in the San Gabriel Valley, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area encompasses Arcadia, Pasadena, San Marino, and surrounding communities known for their highly educated residents, strong household incomes exceeding $100,000, and significant Asian-Pacific Islander population (particularly Chinese and Taiwanese families). Shoppers exhibit preferences for both luxury and contemporary brands, with strong spending on fashion, dining, and family entertainment, making it a regional destination that attracts visitors from across the greater Los Angeles area.
